# Agent N's Hermes News — 2026-10-08

**Executive summary:** Capital and distribution share the lead this cycle. The week's centerpiece is **@NousResearch**'s **[Series B](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-457b765efdb6)**, as reported by the **WSJ**, to take **Hermes Agent** to "new frontiers" (the announcement drew **3.3k+ likes**, amplified by a playful "**[Rated E for Everyone](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-952b0545a74f)**" companion post and a **[NousCon](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-7a4159f4186d)** invite teasing sneak peeks and hiring); **@Teknium** [clarified Nous has now raised four times](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-33e1d0215c17) — including **$70M** before Hermes existed — and [teased upcoming enterprise case-study publications](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-5cc49aed1c71) with **Nvidia** and **Coatue**. No Series B amount was disclosed, so quote it as WSJ-reported, not as a figure. The most actionable product news is the official **[Plugins Marketplace](/?date=2026-10-08&category=news#item-9cb6a9cb347d)** launch — one-click installation of community plugins into **Hermes Desktop**, now the top item in both the News and Research feeds and the anchor of a deliberately plugins-first architecture with **[no native integrations](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-d1c63b50b154)**. Teknium's flagship [positioning post](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-3b1eed8c5e7e) (~250k views / 4.8k likes) argues Hermes was never meant to be only a personal assistant but a general-purpose agent for professionals, [born as his personal coding harness with CLI-first sequencing](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-5d51d706d9e3); candid "[not just for dumb normies](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-8bf7eb984e1b)" follow-ups sparked debate but drew strong community backing, alongside [stats he shared](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-40e113bd6fdd) putting **Meta's Muse** ahead on built-in skills (**30% more**) and default-on tools (**18x more**). The roadmap got concrete: a [web/desktop **GUI app bundled with every portal subscription**](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-afc441b276ce), the previously staffed-up mobile app, revamped onboarding, a [much easier **Gmail** connection path](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-bacc779f9630), a ["more mature feature" shipping next week](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-e90f47a9f402), and a possible **[HermesVoiceBench](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-412e06d590d6)** — while [voice mode landed a week of incremental improvements](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-255577a6e4e3) plus a new [dedicated **auxiliary-model** setting](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-b7f707dc4513) so a heavier model handles hard tasks while voice stays low-latency. Model access stays actionable but is carried, not new: **Solar Mini 4** (35B-total / 3B-active agent-tuned MoE) has been free across **Hermes Cloud**, **Hermes Desktop**, and Agent surfaces since **2026-10-05** ([setup guides](/?date=2026-10-08&category=research#item-b96a6273c3b5) and a [technical explainer](/?date=2026-10-08&category=research#item-a8ab38275ec8) followed), and Aleph Alpha's Apache 2.0 **[Kolibri-1](/?date=2026-10-08&category=research#item-8fd5ff2d0088)** (**78B**, released **2026-10-03**) suits self-hosters. Memory is the cross-cutting theme: **@rlaope**'s **[oh-my-hermes](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-85b54bc8231b)** optimization now reads long-term memory back automatically with writes moved inside the agent loop, joined by **[EngramEdit](/?date=2026-10-08&category=research#item-2610.10533)** research on editable conditional memory (decoupling knowledge updates via n-gram-lookup embeddings) and **[nanoMuse](/?date=2026-10-08&category=research#item-2610.08699)**, an open-source personal agent built around cross-device memory as an open counterpart to Meta's closed **Muse** family; **[DecepEval](/?date=2026-10-08&category=research#item-2610.07967)** (1,532 instances across 28 professional scenarios) anchors the agent-safety thread. Housekeeping is thin: **[v0.20.0](/?date=2026-10-08&category=research#item-hn-49159200)** remains the ship of record (the **v2026.8.3** tag discrepancy stays unresolved — verify before pinning version claims), the only repo activity was the [routine automated daily sync commit](/?date=2026-10-08&category=news#item-9c41cc900be1) (2026-10-07) to hermes-agent-community, and Reddit contributed nothing; the standing [**~23,000 open-PR backlog**](/?date=2026-10-08&category=research#item-hn-49424643) watch-item carries over. Net read: no new Hermes version, no substantive merged PRs, and no new model launches — today's signal is capital plus a distribution channel that turns the community's mod catalog into one-click installs, professional-grade positioning backed by dated roadmap commitments, and a memory/safety research undercurrent worth tracking.

## Releases

No new Hermes version this cycle — **[v0.20.0](/?date=2026-10-08&category=research#item-hn-49159200)** remains the ship of record, with its **[Claude Pro/Max](/?date=2026-10-08&category=research#item-hn-49790991)** subscription support (bringing Anthropic's current lineup, including **Claude-Opus-5.5**, GA **2026-09-22** — which checks out against the model index — into agent workflows at flat subscription cost) and **[Hermes Kanban](/?date=2026-10-08&category=research#item-hn-49604068)** multi-agent docs continuing to anchor the research feed. The real launch is the official **[Plugins Marketplace](/?date=2026-10-08&category=research#item-9cb6a9cb347d)**: one-click installation of community plugins into **Hermes Desktop**, establishing the primary distribution channel for Hermes extensions. This is the formalization of the ~500-mod community catalog momentum from earlier in the week, and the account is now [publicly nudging contributors like **@altryne** to list there](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-eabb57af87a3).

## Merged PRs

Housekeeping only: the routine automated **[Daily sync](/?date=2026-10-08&category=news#item-9c41cc900be1)** commit (2026-10-07) landed on **hermes-agent-community** with no substantive changes — a footnote. The standing **[~23,000 open-PR backlog](/?date=2026-10-08&category=research#item-hn-49424643)** on the core repo remains the project-health counterpoint to the team's breakneck shipping pace.

## Community

- **Funding:** The **WSJ**-reported **[Series B](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-457b765efdb6)** is the story of the week. Beyond the announcement itself, Teknium's [clarifications](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-33e1d0215c17) (four total raises, **$70M** pre-Hermes) and the promised [**Nvidia**/**Coatue** enterprise case studies](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-5cc49aed1c71) suggest the next news cycle will be commercial traction, not just capital.
- **Positioning:** Hermes as a general-purpose agent for professionals — CLI-first origins, ["grows with you" site framing](/?date=2026-10-08&category=research#item-hn-49441992) — with the founder meeting skeptics' consumer-focus objections head-on (and [joking that everyone at **Cursor** breathed a sigh of relief](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-446b05564784)).
- **Roadmap:** [Web/desktop **GUI app** with every portal subscription](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-afc441b276ce), mobile app (now confirmed on the roadmap following this week's staffing news), revamped onboarding, [easier **Gmail** connection](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-bacc779f9630), a [mature feature shipping next week](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-e90f47a9f402), a possible **[HermesVoiceBench](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-412e06d590d6)**, and the new [voice **auxiliary-model** setting](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-b7f707dc4513) — the most immediately useful disclosure for voice users.
- **Memory:** **@rlaope**'s **[oh-my-hermes](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-85b54bc8231b)** round (automatic long-term memory read-back, writes inside the agent loop) is the practical pick; **[EngramEdit](/?date=2026-10-08&category=research#item-2610.10533)** and **[nanoMuse](/?date=2026-10-08&category=research#item-2610.08699)** are the research signals to watch.
- **Ecosystem color:** Teknium [dogfooded that near-stock Hermes builds Hermes itself](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-ece883519dbf), the community shipped [**Hermes gadgets**](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-0d0b054f525a), and a [**nemoclaw** integration has quietly run for 4–5 months](/?date=2026-10-08&category=social#item-27c200a8de0f). Sentiment ran bullish and highly engaged, with **[DecepEval](/?date=2026-10-08&category=research#item-2610.07967)** (1,532 instances, 28 professional scenarios) giving the reliability discussion a concrete benchmark.

*(Tips & Tutorials omitted — nothing cleared the freshness bar this cycle. Reddit contributed nothing.)*

top_items.title: Hermes Agent Plugins Marketplace: One-Click Plugins for Hermes Desktop
top_items.content:
The Hermes Agent plugins marketplace lets you install community plugins into Hermes Desktop in one click — voice like Jarvis, a live news feed, job search, multi-device control and hundreds more, all free. In the video below I install a few live. Here’s how the marketplace works and the one check you must do before installing anything.

Key takeaways

The official plugin catalogue lives on the Hermes Agent docs site and inside Hermes Desktop’s capabilities section.
It has official and community plugins — around 500 when I recorded.
Click Open in Hermes Desktop, choose a profile, and install.
Always check the GitHub repo before installing a community plugin.






What the Hermes Agent plugins marketplace is
Nous Research launched an official plugin catalogue for Hermes Agent, which you can reach on the Hermes Agent docs site or in the capabilities section of Hermes Desktop. It started with a handful of official plugins and around a hundred community ones, and it has grown fast — I counted about 500 when I recorded.
Each listing shows its star rating, when it was last updated and its version, and you can filter by category — memory, voice, messaging, browsing, desktop panes and more. Nous says it reviews community plugins, and anyone can submit their own.
How to install from the Hermes Agent plugins marketplace

Browse the catalogue and open a plugin.
Click Open in Hermes Desktop, then Open Hermes.
Choose where it appears (for example, in the desktop UI) and which profile gets it.
Click Install — done.

I installed Hermes Newswire this way. In its settings I added a topic — “Hermes Agent” — searched for release notes, and within seconds there was a scrolling news feed along the bottom of my chats. You can add sources, change the speed, pause it or switch it off.

You don’t need all of them. Pick the ones that fit how you work — and for categories with lots of options, like voice, I’d choose the one with the most stars.
Why plugins beat the old terminal setup
Before this, adding a capability to Hermes meant the terminal, config files and sometimes three hours on a GitHub skill that didn’t even work. Now it’s one click, and the ratings help you skip the dead ones. If you still want the manual route, each plugin page has its installation instructions and README.
For connecting apps like Gmail or Notion, see my Hermes Agent connectors guide — and for a solid base setup, my best Hermes setup walkthrough.
Check every plugin before you install it

Community plugins are open-source projects written by anyone. Check them before you install — a plugin runs with your agent’s access.


Open the GitHub repository before you install and read the README — what it does, what it needs access to.
Check the stars and last-updated date in the catalogue; abandoned plugins break.
Install into a test profile first — Hermes lets you choose which profile a plugin goes into.
Pick one plugin per job — one voice plugin, not five.
Never paste keys into a plugin you haven’t vetted.

An SEO audit procedure

Gmail, Notion, GitHub




Plugins change what Hermes itself can do; skills teach it how to do a job; connectors give it access to your apps. You’ll often use all three together. For memory specifically, see my Hermes memory plugins guide.
My starter set of Hermes plugins

One voice plugin — the most-starred one, so you can talk to Hermes hands-free.
Hermes Newswire — set to your niche, so news comes to you.
Hermes Tailscale — if you use Hermes on more than one device.
A search plugin — Brave Search is a good free option.
Hermes Office 2 — if you like seeing your agents work visually.

Five plugins, each solving one problem. Add more only when you have a specific need. Fewer plugins means fewer things to update and fewer things that can break.
How to remove or update a Hermes plugin
Plugins aren’t permanent. Each one has its own settings page in Hermes Desktop where you can switch it on or off without uninstalling it — handy for testing whether a plugin is causing a problem. If you don’t use a plugin any more, uninstall it rather than leaving it switched off.
Check the catalogue now and then for updates: the last-updated date tells you whether a plugin is still maintained. If Hermes starts behaving oddly after an update, switch off the plugins you added most recently one at a time until you find the culprit. Keeping a spare test profile makes all of this painless.

- Open the model settings and refresh the model list.

- Edit the models and select Solar Mini 4 from the free models.

- Send a test message — mine replied instantly.

## Using Solar Mini 4 in the Hermes dashboard or Agent OS

If you run the dashboard, type `hermes dashboard` in your terminal, open Models, choose Set main model, search “solar”, go to the Nous Portal section and pick the free Solar Mini 4. Inside Agent OS, add the Solar Mini 4 profile under Hermes and chat with it directly.

Free models can get rate limited. If that happens, refresh the model list and switch to another free model. The free list in Nous Portal when I recorded included:

- Upstage Solar Mini 4

- Poolside Laguna XS 2.1

- inclusionAI Ling 3.1 Flash and Ling 3.0 Flash

- StepFun Step 3.7 Flash

- Meituan LongCat 2.0

- Solar Mini 4 isn’t in the list — refresh the model list; new free models don’t always show until you do.

- Unexpected charges — you’ve picked the paid entry. Switch to the free one under Nous Portal.

- Rate limit errors — wait a few minutes or switch profile to another free model.

- Memory is off — a new profile starts with memory switched off; turn it on in the profile settings if you want it.

- Slow replies in Agent OS — check you’ve selected the Solar Mini 4 profile, not your default one.

- Daily AI news research and summaries

- Researching competitors or topics before a piece of content

- Turning notes and transcripts into structured outlines

- Simple scheduled tasks that run every day

Upstage is a South Korean AI company, and Solar Mini 4 is a model it pretrained from scratch specifically for agents — high-volume, repetitive work like retrieving information, producing structured output and calling tools, at low cost. Because it’s a mixture-of-experts model, only 3 billion of its 35 billion parameters are used for each token, which is why it’s so fast.

top_items.content:
oh-my-hermes — optimization round

Long-term memory: Hermes remembers what you told it last week and brings it back on its own next time. Install OMH and it just works — nothing to approve, nothing to configure.

Install Once: https://t.co/g1exHwWK5E

• Memory was being saved but never read. Fixed — and the model now records memories itself; safe ones are approved automatically.
• Memory writes moved inside the plugin. No more depending on an external omh command being found on PATH.
• One source of truth for router parsing, runtime schemas, budget limits and skill metadata — fix once, fixed everywhere. No behavior change.
• Two order-dependent bugs fixed and gated: a plugin fallback that stuck on its local copy while the router was still loading, and `omh memory pack` returning empty for an explicit scope while leaking other sessions' thread memory.
• Windows: the plugin lock file now retries instead of failing on a held file.
